item.title: Colom wins Mississippi Senate race. And, White House warns Dems over future probes
item.description: After more than a week of counting ballots, Scott Colom has narrowly won the Mississippi Senate seat. And, the White House has sent a letter warning Democrats who plan to investigate the administration.
item.content:encoded:
After more than a week of counting ballots, Scott Colom has narrowly won the Mississippi Senate seat. And, the White House has sent a letter warning Democrats who plan to investigate the administration.

item.description: NPR's A Martinez speaks with former U.S. ambassador to Ukraine, William Taylor, about the ongoing peace talks between the U.S., Russia and Ukraine.

item.title: U.S. officials set to meet with Putin, Zelenskyy following Abu Dhabi peace talks
item.description: U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi have wrapped up with an agreement on a Russia-Ukraine prisoner exchange. U.S. negotiators meet with Vladimir Putin on Thursday and Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Friday.

item.title: Drought threatens Iraq's marshes, risking one of the oldest ways of life
item.description: The unique marshes of southern Iraq are beginning to revive after five years of devastating drought. But challenges remain for one of the world's oldest ways of life.
item.content:encoded: The unique marshes of southern Iraq are beginning to revive after five years of devastating drought. But challenges remain for one of the world's oldest ways of life.

item.title: Aid groups call on Israel to allow shelters in Gaza amid a humanitarian emergency
item.description: Winter storms have brought flooding and deadly landslides to thousands living in tents in Gaza. Palestinians have no where to go after years of devasting war.

item.title: Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital kills 6 people, health authorities say
item.description: The victims included a surgeon, and dozens more were injured. Israel said it was targeting a Hamas commander and other militants.

item.title: Greetings from Senegal, where breakdancers are competing in the Youth Olympics
item.description: Senegal's breakdancers have been practicing for their country's historic hosting of the Youth Olympic Games this month. It's the first time Africa is hosting an Olympic event.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to a prisoner exchange as talks end with no big breakthrough
item.description: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war. U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi led to this decision, marking the biggest humanitarian release since the war began in 2022.

item.title: House effectively ends Hegseth impeachment. And, 3 men accused of plotting U.K. attacks
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has been spared from the House's impeachment effort, at least for now. And, federal prosecutors arrested three men accused of being Iran-backed operatives.
